display_long_description:
Punch the Buddy, now in VR! Play with friends. Grab weapons, explosives, and physics toys to beat down your ragdoll Buddy. Earn cash, level up, and unlock even crazier items.

# 70+ Weapons to Unlock
Endlessly satisfying demolition with tons of epic weapons, god powers, and vehicles. Every weapon hits harder than the last.
[media]

# Multiplayer Mayhem with Friends

Jump into chaotic public lobbies, or go private with your friends. Unleash havoc on the Buddies (or each other).
[media]

# Helicopters, UFOs, and Superpowers
Ram Buddies with vehicles, fling them with superpowers, and rig booby traps across wild maps built for combos, trickshots, and carnage. Mix it up with different characters, each with unique buddy-crushing powers.

[media]

# Level Up, Upgrade, and Unlock
Every hit earns you XP and cash – unlock the most powerful weapons in the game and amplify their destruction with unique buffs.

[media]

# A Major FREE Update Every Month – Vote on What's Next!
New weapons, characters, vehicles, and modes have shipped every month since launch – and we're not slowing down. Join our Discord to vote on updates, share your videos in our creator program, and get special access to releases and giveaways.

**🔗 https://discord.gg/nY9hsQ7qjQ**

Fudgy – "OH MY GOODNESS HIS HEAD ACTUALLY CAME OFF! THAT'S SO COOL!"

LuxoticVR – "One of the best free multiplayer Quest games I've found in a while"
